items.title: AI infrastructure rebound accelerates into holiday-shortened market close
items.summary: US stocks recovered from early volatility as technology shares led gains into the shortened session close. Storage, networking and data-center power shares participated in the rally. Elevated Treasury yields and concerns over AI profitability and financing remain unresolved.

observations.label: November 27 1 PM ET close, AP and WSJ
observations.value: Nasdaq +2.3%, S&P 500 +1.6%, Dow +1.2%; independently reported.

observations.label: Barron's session observations
observations.value: SNDK +13%, MRVL +5.5%, BE +4.7%; not independently verified closing prices.

observations.label: Risk context
observations.value: AP reports 10-year Treasury yield 4.93%; WSJ reports Nasdaq approximately 13% below October peak.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Monday normal-volume trading, semiconductor breadth, credit spreads and infrastructure spending commitments; renewed selling would weaken the recovery signal.

items.key_finding: The technology rebound strengthened into the close, but holiday liquidity and unresolved funding risks limit evidence of a durable reversal.

items.title: CENTCOM reports additional commercial vessel disabled during Iran blockade enforcement
items.summary: US Central Command disclosed an additional blockade enforcement incident in the Gulf of Oman involving a commercial bulk carrier on November 26. The announcement reinforces ongoing maritime disruption risk. The vessel was not an oil tanker and the incident does not establish additional crude-export losses.

observations.label: Official CENTCOM announcement, November 27
observations.value: Commercial bulk carrier disabled November 26; civilian crew unharmed.

observations.label: Enforcement totals reported by CENTCOM
observations.value: 158 compliant commercial vessels redirected; six noncompliant vessels disabled during the current campaign.

observations.label: Energy ETF observations
observations.value: Investing.com reports XLE +1.49% and XOP +1.40% in separate snapshots; not independently verified matching closing prices.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Iraqi cargo loading schedules, independent tanker volumes, war-risk insurance premiums and November 29 OPEC+ decision; stable cargo flows would weaken the immediate crude-supply concern.

items.key_finding: Officially reported blockade enforcement reinforces shipping risk without establishing incremental crude-export losses.

items.title: CoreWeave's proposed Meta-backed loan tests AI infrastructure funding
items.summary: Banks are reportedly preparing a customer-backed loan sale for CoreWeave as early as next week. Management previously outlined the secured financing strategy, which could reduce borrowing costs relative to unsecured debt. The proposed deal is not yet closed and corporate credit risk remains.

observations.label: Bloomberg November 25 report
observations.value: Proposed $4.5 billion GPU-secured loan; indicative yield 7–7.5%; terms and timing subject to change.

observations.label: Unsecured credit comparison
observations.value: CoreWeave 9% senior notes due 2031 yielded 18% on November 25 according to TRACE data cited by Bloomberg.

observations.label: Company Q3 results
observations.value: Revenue backlog approximately $132.5 billion as of September 30, 2026; contingent on delivery and service availability.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Final syndication terms, ratings, demand, customer prepayments and interest expense; failure to close or higher borrowing costs would weaken the funding case.

items.key_finding: Customer-backed secured financing may reduce project funding costs while leaving significant parent-company credit exposure.

sources.title: Bloomberg November 25 report via Yahoo Finance
Barron's November earnings and financing coverage

items.title: Energy tanker tracking provides counterpoint to rising Hormuz security risk
items.summary: Vortexa tracking indicates energy tanker traffic improved earlier in November despite increasing maritime threats. The dataset covers a different vessel population and period than the latest assisted-transit figures. Larger tanker movements and high shipping costs remain concerns; incremental physical crude-export losses are not established.

observations.label: Vortexa data reported November 26 by Bloomberg
observations.value: Seven-day average energy tanker transits above 26 through November 19 versus below 25 on at least two-thirds of October days; larger crude carriers declined slightly while smaller vessel movements rose.

observations.label: Shipping costs
observations.value: Freight and additional insurance fees reported near wartime highs; exact current rates not verified.

observations.label: JMIC comparison, November 26
observations.value: US-assisted transits averaged approximately 32/day November 22–25 versus 38/day November 19–21; distinct population and interval.

observations.label: Reuters November 27, 10:16 AM ET intraday
observations.value: Brent $95.20, down $1.42; WTI $83.74, up 0.06% versus Wednesday close.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Actual cargo tonnage, Iraqi loading schedules, freight and insurance premiums, OPEC+ November 29; sustained flows would weaken the near-term scarcity case.

items.key_finding: Rising maritime risk does not necessarily imply falling energy tanker counts or measurable incremental export losses.

items.title: Large Coherent insider purchases coincide with optical networking rebound
items.summary: Recent regulatory disclosures describe substantial purchases of Coherent shares through a director-associated investment entity. The company has reported strong revenue growth and improving gross margins as optical connectivity demand increases. The purchases predate Friday's rebound and do not establish undervaluation.

observations.label: Reported purchases November 20–24
observations.value: 251,910 shares for approximately $49.9 million; filings November 24–25. Indirect ownership through an investment entity.

observations.label: Friday premarket report updated 8:36 AM ET
observations.value: COHR +7.79%; not a closing figure.

observations.label: November 4 fiscal Q1 results
observations.value: Revenue $2.37 billion, +50% year over year; GAAP gross margin 39.1%, up 254 basis points. Management expects fiscal 2027 pro forma revenue growth above 60%.

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Customer capital spending, manufacturing capacity, margins, valuation and new filings; weaker orders or margin execution would weaken the case.

items.key_finding: Large disclosed insider purchases and strong operating results warrant further optical infrastructure research, without establishing a valuation anomaly.
